title: ECP Protected Store Manifest
description: Deterministic manifest and identity document of a protected evidence store (R1-I, Option C minimal coupled foundation). The store lives OUTSIDE the public repository and holds sealed ground-truth blobs in content-addressed, write-once storage. This manifest indexes the seals and checkpoints the store operation log (oplog) head. manifest_hash = SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization of this document with the top-level manifest_hash field removed. The manifest is a derived, verifiable index: full integrity is established by recomputation (store-verify) of the oplog chain, the seal index and the blob hashes, not by trusting this file. scope 'development' marks a store holding only synthetic, clearly-marked fixtures - never scientific evidence (mirrors the dev/public ledger separation); 'operational' marks the real protected store.

scope.description: 'development' = synthetic fixtures only, never scientific evidence, never published; 'operational' = the real protected store holding sealed ground truth.

created_at.description: Claimed creation timestamp of the store (assertion, not evidence).

blob_count.description: Number of sealed ground-truth blobs in the zone (equals the number of distinct commitments).

hidden-cases.description: Reserved for non-public case documents; not implemented at R1-I.

evidence.description: Reserved for post-execution evidence bundles (append-only ingestion contract designed in M3-R1; implementation deferred to the execution gate).

exports.description: Reserved for disclosure-governed export packages; not implemented at R1-I.

commitment.description: SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization of the sealed ground-truth document.

blob_path.description: Content-addressed storage path of the blob, relative to the store root. The path is a function of the content hash: 'modifying' a blob produces a different path, leaving the original bytes in place.

blob_hash.description: SHA-256 over the raw bytes of the blob file. Invariant: the blob stores the canonical serialization, so blob_hash equals commitment; store-verify checks this equality explicitly.

oplog_index.description: Index of the oplog entry recording the seal.

seals.description: Seal index, sorted by (case_id, case_version) ascending. Exactly one seal per (case_id, case_version): write-once. Entries are derived from the oplog and re-derived on verification.

head_oplog_hash.description: oplog_hash of the last oplog entry (64 zeros when entry_count is 0). This is the digest that can be checkpointed into the ledger anchoring.

manifest_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical serialization of this document with the top-level manifest_hash field removed.
